flexible_learning.content:
Final Project online Presentations:

Students will work in groups to develop a practical final project related to artificial intelligence and optoelectronics applications. Students may select topics involving machine learning, deep learning, computer vision, generative AI, intelligent systems, or AI agents applied to optical sensing, image processing, optical communication, smart healthcare, or related fields.

Students will submit a final project report and present their results in
flexible_learning.outcome:
Upon completion of the flexible learning activities, students will be able to:
- Apply artificial intelligence techniques to solve a practical problem related to optoelectronics or a related application domain.
- Select and use suitable AI programming tools, frameworks, and learning resources to implement a proposed solution.
- Analyze and interpret experimental or simulation results to evaluate the performance of an AI-based system.
- Write project report and present their findings
flexible_learning.assessment_ratio:
The flexible learning activities in Weeks 17–18 account for 30% of the final course grade.

Students will be assessed on their application of AI concepts, problem-solving ability, quality of implementation, interpretation of results, and communication skills. For group projects, individual contributions will also be considered.
